findings.reason: the role axis of the vocabulary is a stated endpoint that the section's only gate cannot fail, so the fix is one clause that either grades an omitted decided role partly right or ties the stated-role count to the number of described signals whose role the vocabulary decided.
findings.text: s6 Delivers requires "a description states the signal's quantity, unit and role where the vocabulary of section 11 decided them", but the grade on line 70 makes only an omitted "quantity or unit" partly right and sends a description that states everything supported and omits a decided role to "right"; the aggregate count "the number of member descriptions that state each of the three vocabulary values" carries no target, so a run whose descriptions state no role at all meets every clause of the done-when, including the bar

findings.reason: the reading decides pass or fail on exactly this ambiguity, so the plan needs one clause stating that a value the vocabulary decided is not counted unsupported merely because the specification is silent, or that the reading judges only claims the specification addresses.
findings.text: the grade makes a description "wrong when it states something the functional specification contradicts or does not support", while Delivers obliges the writer to state every quantity, unit and role §11 decided and most decided values are credited to the controls metadata and the field pattern rather than to a signal-list row (c-s11-landed: "Most decided values are credited to the controls metadata"), which the functional specification need not mention; a description that obeys Delivers can therefore be counted wrong for obeying it, and the pass bar of at most two wrong of forty is then decided by an instrument whose rule conflicts with the section's own instruction
